title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Title**


Project Engineer**Job Description Summary**


This Role is part of PDS\-Investors Team, and selected candidates will be working on project management consultancy or construction management projects managed by Cushman \& Wakefield.**Job Description**

**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

The Mechanical Engineer (PMC) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of all mechanical works on the project. The role involves design review, site supervision, coordination with stakeholders, and ensuring that mechanical systems are delivered as per specifications, quality standards, timelines, and safety requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical drawings, specifications, and technical submittals (HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, utilities).
* Supervise and monitor on\-site mechanical works to ensure compliance with approved drawings.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and site teams for smooth execution of mechanical activities.
* Assist in identifying design issues, clashes, and support resolution with consultants.
* Ensure adherence to QA/QC procedures and quality standards.
* Track daily site progress and update reports for mechanical scope.
* Verify quantities and support in checking contractor RA bills.
* Assist in planning and scheduling of mechanical activities.
* Support testing and commissioning activities of mechanical systems.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards and site regulations.

**About You:**

* Good knowledge of mechanical systems (HVAC, firefighting, plumbing)
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
* Strong coordination and communication skills
* Basic understanding of QA/QC processes
* Problem\-solving ability at site level
* Proficiency in MS Office and AutoCAD

**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.  

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**

 *That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*

*We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.*

  


INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”

title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad

**Experience:** 1 to 3 Years

**Salary:** As per market standard

**Job Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site \| Immediate Joining Preferred

Role Overview

PVblink Technology Pvt. Ltd., a leading solar inverter manufacturing company under the Make in India initiative, is looking for an energetic and technically sound Service Engineer to join our growing service network.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintenance and troubleshooting of solar inverters and systems, ensuring reliable performance and excellent customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

* Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues on\-site and remotely
* Provide technical support to clients, dealers, and distributors
* Maintain detailed service reports and documentation
* Collaborate with the service teams to resolve complex issues
* Ensure timely completion of service calls and maintain good client relationships

Qualifications

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, or related field
* Basic knowledge of solar inverters, power systems, and field troubleshooting preferred
* Solar EPC experience required
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Freshers with technical knowledge and willingness to learn are welcome

Why Join PV Blink?

* Work with India’s fastest\-growing solar inverter manufacturer
* Get hands\-on exposure to advanced solar technologies and on\-site service
* Opportunity for career growth into technical specialist or service leadership roles
* Supportive team, field training, and growth\-focused environment

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in Solar Industry ?
* Do you have experience in Service Engineer?
* What is your Current Location?

Work Location: In person

title: OSP Engineer (FTTH)
description:
An OSP engineer works on the physical network infrastructure located***outside buildings, including fiber\-optic cables and their routes.***

**Job Responsibilities**

\- Design outside plant fiber networks and physical cable routes.

\- Work on fiber network designs for connections going to homes, offices, and other locations.

\- Prepare and modify designs using AutoCAD and fiber network design tools.

\- Coordinate geographically with team members working from the USA.

\- Work with geographical information and route planning for fiber networks.

\- Coordinate with relevant teams throughout the network design process.

**Mandatory Skills:** 

\- ***AutoCAD experience is compulsory.***

\- Excellent English communication

\- Good understanding of engineering/design concepts

\- Knowledge of fiber network design will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
